On 19 September, Vlyt Art Acting presents the first cast Dramatised Reading in our De Nieuwe Ridderorde Reading Series.

Our contemporary cast brings Scene 2 of Charles Étienne Boniface’s 1832 play — regarded as the first South African play — to life through dramatic reading.

📅 19 September | 10:00–12:00
📍 GLACIER , Pretoria
🎟️ R150 — Tickets available on Quicket in bio

Come meet the cast and experience Boniface’s characters brought to life by contemporary South African actors.

Vlyt Art Acting
Door Yver Bloeit de Kunst

Drodzy Kierowcy,

Na plan serialu **w Warszawie** szukam **STATYSTÓW Z AUTAMI** na środę 16.09.

Szukam aut miejskich w stonowanych kolorach. Bez białych i czerwonych.

After our summer break Chromolume Theatre is back with the breakdown for our final show of our 2026 Season of Identity and Expression, the first fully staged production of the Sondheim/Weidman musical Road Show, directed by Joanna Syiek with musical direction by Richard Berent!  (Note: this is very much an ensemble show, with strong singer/actor/performers needed.)

As always, please submit ALL ETHNICITIES FOR ALL ROLES!

Synopsis: Road Show is a tale of dreamers, based on the true story of the Mizner Brothers, who scramble for success, identity and love at the turn of the twentieth century.

Director: Joanna Syiek

Musical Director: Richard Berent

Audition Date(s): 09/26/2026, 09/27/2026

Callback Date(s): 09/30/2026

Rehearsal Date(s): 10/05/2026, 10/12/2026 to 11/18/2026

Preview Date(s): 11/19/2026

Opening Date(s): 11/20/2026

Closing Date(s): 12/06/2026

Location: The Zephyr Theatre

Rate: $400 honorarium, $300 for Understudies

SUBMIT ELECTRONICALLY: Email headshot & resume to casting@chrtheatre.com, NO VIDEO SUBMISSIONS

SPECIAL NOTE: Auditions are by invitation only and not all submissions will be brought in for an audition. You will be asked to please prepare a 16-32 bar selection of song in the style of the show.  NO WEBBER. An Accompanist will be provided. Bring sheet music in the correct key and cut to length ideally showing the range of the character for which you are auditioning.  Non-AEA

THERE WILL BE UNDERSTUDIES CAST FOR THE ROLES OF WILSON, AND ADDISON, RESPECTIVELY WITH TWO GUARANTEED PERFORMANCES.

Addison: Male Presenting, 30-50. The levelheaded brother living in the shadows of Wilson's schemes. A visionary artist with flair and guile. Cares for his mother. Not as prone to seizing the world as his brother. Easily influenced by his older brother.  Vocal Range: G5-F3.

Wilson: Male Presenting, 30-50. Handsome and charming. Always has a good time, but also lowlife con artist involved in a series of scams. Lives his life as one big, adventurous attempt to seize opportunity. The greedy, selfish brother to Addison.  Vocal Range: A5-F3.

Hollis Bessemer: Male Presenting, 25-30. An honest businessman who rejects the family business to build his dream of an artist colony. Partners with Addison to create an extremely successful real estate business and finally a fortune of his own. Sensitive. Loves Addison. Vocal Range: G5-B3.

Mama: Female Presenting, 50-65. Mother to Addison and Wilson. Encourages her sons to follow opportunity by any means necessary. Coddles Wilson, whom she clearly favors, and ultimately loses him to his own greed. Depends on Addison to take care of her. Vocal Range: E5-G3.

Papa: Male Presenting, 55-75. Father to Addison and Wilson. On his deathbed, he tells his sons to embrace the opportunities of the new world. Proud. Nostalgic.  Vocal Range: E5-A3.

Ensemble: Male and female Presenting, 20s – 50s. All types and singing ranges. Need fantastic singing voices and dynamic personalities to play various roles in the ensemble.

[https://chrtheatre.com/auditions](https://chrtheatre.com/auditions?fbclid=IwcGRvZgVleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFqc2FFUE1tbVg5d3RxZFN0c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHo_sJEci2agp51x9Im1hpdYeZ20RKFfoJ_WChpIwJtaMGcmMdglgfEu96t3Y_aem_XRkbEP9vyBpxJooNnLHXdA)

„Heartaches By The Number“ - ein Klassiker der Countrymusik.

1959 von Harlan Howard geschrieben und von zwei Künstlern fast zeitgleich veröffentlicht: Ray Price und Guy Mitchell (in einer Popversion). Es folgten noch ganz viele Künstler, die das unschöne Thema Liebeskummer in ein fröhliches Gewand gekleidet haben. Auch wir haben uns daran versucht. Was meint Ihr dazu?

**Pełna kontrola:** Sam decydujesz, w jakich branżach i projektach się pojawisz, a w jakich nie.

**Dlaczego warto dołączyć już teraz? Mamy bonusy na start:** **Licencje od AlterCast:** W tym tygodniu nasza platforma sama będzie wykupywać licencje od pierwszych zarejestrowanych osób. **Płacimy za feedback:** Ponieważ to pierwsza fala, zależy nam na opinii. Załóż konto, przetestuj proces i napisz mi szczerze, czy wszystko było jasne – przewidzieliśmy za to dodatkowe wynagrodzenie dla 50 osób.

Rejestracja jest w pełni darmowa i do niczego nie zobowiązuje.

**Zostaw komentarz pod postem albo napisz do mnie od razu na priv!** Wyślę Ci link do założenia konta, opowiem o szczegółach i chętnie pomogę przejść przez cały proces rejestracji.

**Title**: Clear Eyed

**Genre**: (Drama, Horror, Tragedy.)

**Logline**: A young man struggles to hold onto his sanity as the silent image of his dead, schizophrenic brother haunts him whenever the bandages covering his missing eye are off.

**Roles**

*Drew* - Male, Early 20s: A sweet but reserved young man. He tries his best to handle his problems alone, but after losing his eye in an accident, his hallucinations get out of control. Now he's struggling to hold on to his sanity.

*Alice *- Female, Late 20s: Drew’s supportive and put together older sister. She’s lost a lot of family to this mental illness and can’t lose anyone else. She’s trying her best to keep Drew safe, but is it enough?

*Justin* - Male, Early 20s The hallucination of Drew’s dead older brother. He’s ghostly pale with a bloody bruise from a noose around his neck. The shell of their brother is a silent reminder of the illness plaguing the family.

**Production Company**: Director - Holly Mathews, Writer/Producer: Theo Henderson

**Production Type**: Student Film

**Contact Information**: email - [theo.b.henderson@gmail.com](mailto:theo.b.henderson@gmail.com) 

Casting Form - [https://forms.gle/HiJyrYaKQEuBmmwb8](https://forms.gle/HiJyrYaKQEuBmmwb8) 

**Run Time**: Short

## **CASTING CALL FOR FEATURE FILM - CHEDDAR POP **

What started as a proof of concept short, has blown up to a full feature shoot!  “Cheddar Pop", is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.  We only succeed, together. 

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”

Location: Greater Aurora, CO. Area. Exact locations TBD

Shoot Dates: Now through December (**Extreme Schedule Flexibility a must since we will be filming in live business locations.)**

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, (for now) meals provided. Proportional cast profit splits when sold. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

Roles available for any age or any level of experience. Character Descriptions and number of scenes here : [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cAiAADfijNUpa9gNIxYqcP_g9JSIlx3KaBN0TLwOVCw/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cAiAADfijNUpa9gNIxYqcP_g9JSIlx3KaBN0TLwOVCw/edit?usp=sharing) 

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by September 25, 2026. See less

**NOW HIRING IN:**

**• Vancouver, BC**

**• Edmonton, AB**

**• Calgary, AB**

**• Ottawa, ON**

**• Toronto, ON**

**• San Francisco, CA**

**• Seattle, WA**

**Role Snapshot**
* Dates: **October 6–31, 2026**
* Schedule: **Thursday–Sunday, primarily evenings with some weekend afternoon sessions**
* Typical shift: **approximately 3–5 hours**
* Pay: **$26.50 per hour + tips**
* Engagement: **Independent contractor**
* Future work: **strong performers will be offered priority for our December Christmas pop-up experiences**

**About Nightmare Bar**

Nightmare Bar is an immersive Halloween pop-up experience combining themed cocktails, theatrical entertainment, interactive games, challenges, music and a Halloween-inspired atmosphere. Each ticketed session hosts approximately 40–50 guests for a 90-minute experience.

This is more than a standard MC role. We need someone who can command a room, make people laugh, improvise, interact directly with guests and bring a dark, playful Halloween character to life.

**The Role**

As the Lead Nightmare Bar Host, you will run the entertainment experience throughout each session. You will:
* Welcome guests and introduce them to Nightmare Bar
* Host the 90-minute experience
* Run interactive games, challenges, trivia and competitions
* Use a microphone confidently and control the energy of the room
* Move between tables and interact directly with guests
* Improvise and create memorable individual guest moments
* Encourage participation in Nightmare Bar challenges and activities
* Host costume competitions and prize moments
* Activate theatrical elements including the Nightmare telephone experience
* Read and interact with guest confession cards
* Work with music and basic show cues
* Keep the experience running to schedule
* Help reset entertainment props between sessions
* Liaise with the venue and Nightmare Bar team during the shift

* When not on the microphone, the Host should not be standing around waiting for the next activity. You should be moving through the venue, talking to guests, improvising, creating jokes and keeping the Nightmare Bar world alive.

**Who We're Looking For**

Particularly interested in candidates with experience in:
* Live event hosting
* Acting
* Improv comedy
* Immersive theatre
* Trivia or gameshow hosting
* Character entertainment
* Theme parks
* Halloween attractions
* Murder mystery events
* MC / entertainment work
* Interactive hospitality experiences

*Professional acting experience isn't essential. Personality, confidence and the ability to entertain a room matter more. We're looking for the person who can walk into a bar with 50 people, grab a microphone and immediately make everyone want to pay attention.

**Candidate Profile**
* Charismatic and outgoing
* Naturally funny and quick-thinking
* Very comfortable speaking on a microphone
* Comfortable approaching and interacting with strangers
* Strong at improvisation
* Able to read a room and know when to increase or reduce guest interaction
* Reliable and punctual
* Comfortable working in a busy bar environment
* Available Thursday–Sunday throughout the October run, including some weekend afternoons
* Comfortable performing multiple sessions in one shift
* Able to work professionally around alcohol while remaining sober on shift

**Performance Style**

Nightmare Bar is dark, playful, theatrical, funny, immersive and slightly strange. It is not a traditional haunted house.

We are **not** looking for constant screaming, jump scares, gore or aggressive guest interaction. *Think a charismatic,* Halloween host with strong improvisational acting ability, rather than a haunted-house scare actor.

**How to Apply**

Applicants should email the requested information to ashlynn@showtime-presents.com . Please include:
* Name and city
* Recent photo or headshot
* Relevant acting, hosting, improv or entertainment experience
* Confirmation of October 6–31 availability
* A short video introducing yourself and showing your personality

***Bonus*: a 30–60 second video showing how you would welcome a room of guests into a strange Halloween bar. We're looking for performers who can make guests leave saying "the Host absolutely made the experience."

CASTING CALL: 1 ACTOR and 1 ACTRESS NEEDED! 

American Playlist Theater (APT) is looking for one actor and one actress to join the cast of our upcoming production:

THE HOLIDAY RADIO THEATER EXTRAVAGANZA 

[https://www.garrisonplayers.org/holiday-radio-extravaganza](https://www.garrisonplayers.org/holiday-radio-extravaganza)

Where: 
Garrison Players Arts Center
Rollinsford, NH

When:
December 4–13, 2026
Fridays at 7:30 PM
Saturdays at 4:00 PM
Sundays at 2:00 PM

Imagine stepping back into the Golden Age of Radio where stand actors at microphones, live Foley sound effects, music, and an announcer, with a live audience enjoying the story.

The Holiday Radio Theater Extravaganza is a collection of original comedic and heartwarming holiday stories, written and directed by Sean Sullivan, presented as a live radio broadcast on stage.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

One actor
One actress

The roles involve playing multiple characters throughout the production, so we're looking for performers who enjoy voice work, character changes, comedy, and ensemble performance.

Experience is NOT required. If you want to perform, like having a good time, or simply want to try something completely different, we'd love to hear from you.

Rehearsals of the shows begin this Tuesday, so jump on board before you'll need to catch up. Come make some Christmas magic with us!

American Playlist Theater Live Radio Theater Reimagined
Learn more about APT and the production at our website [https://americanplaylistth.wixsite.com/website](https://americanplaylistth.wixsite.com/website)

Interested? Send me a message and let's talk!
And if it's not for you...cool! but consider sharing on your page for a friend who might be interested

Sean Sullivan
Writer/Director, American Playlist Theater 
americanplaylisttheater@gmail.com

🎬 DON’T PLAY WITH ME — ONLINE CASTING SUBMISSIONS 🎬
Thank you to everyone who attended the Don’t Play With Me casting call! Some amazing talent came through, and we truly appreciate everyone’s time, preparation and energy.
If you missed the casting call but still want to be a part of the film, online submissions will be accepted through September 19, 2026.
Available roles:
Princess: African American woman, 40–55. Sophisticated, strict, loving and protective.
Reggie: African American man, 18–25. Funny, confident and charming.
Windle: African American man, 35–50. Mature, confident and emotionally complex.
Stone: African American man, 30–50. Strong, intimidating and authoritative.
Dak: African American man, 18–28. Tall, athletic, attractive and charismatic.
FOXX: African American, 18–30. Talented, competitive and confident with a strong stage presence.
Female Rival Rapper: African American woman, 18–30. Fierce, confident, hard and street-smart.
Frost: African American man, 30–50. Mature, outspoken and commanding.
Becky: African American woman, 18–25. Intelligent, ambitious, friendly and outspoken.
Rosa Lee: Hispanic/Latina woman, 18–25. Intelligent, caring, ambitious and confident.
Big Man/Dre: African American man, 25–40. Large or physically strong, protective, funny and dependable.
Arielle: African American woman, 18–30. Attractive, social, expressive and self-assured.
Lisa: Caucasian woman, 18–25. Attractive, friendly, social and expressive.
Teenage Girl: Caucasian girl, 14–17. Youthful, confident and expressive.
Young Woman: Caucasian woman, 18–25. Friendly, confident and outgoing.
Ms. Debbie: African American woman, 40–65. Warm, confident and musically gifted. Must be able to sing.
Pastor: African American man or woman, 35–65. Mature, spiritual, compassionate and authoritative.
Professor Dunlap: Man or woman of any ethnicity, 35–65. Professional, intelligent and authoritative.
Teen Rappers/Students: Boys and girls, 14–17, of all ethnicities. Must be energetic and expressive. Rap ability is preferred.
Adult Extras: Men and women, 18+, of all ethnicities. College students, dancers, musicians, judges, church members and audience members.
Choose a character and clearly state who you are auditioning for. Please submit:
Your headshot
Acting résumé, if available
A video of your best monologue
A short rap performance when applying for a rap role
Parents or legal guardians must submit or approve submissions for anyone under 18.
Send submissions to Carterboyzent2017@gmail.com.
Thank you for your interest!
Carterboyz Entertainment
#DontPlayWithMe #OnlineAuditions #CastingCall #TeenActors #JacksonvilleActors #CarterboyzEntertainment

🎬 DON’T PLAY WITH ME — ONLINE CASTING SUBMISSIONS 🎬
Thank you to everyone who attended the Don’t Play With Me casting call! Some amazing talent came through, and we truly appreciate everyone’s time, preparation and energy.
If you missed the casting call but still want to be a part of the film, online submissions will be accepted through September 19, 2026.
Available roles:
Princess: African American woman, 40–55. Sophisticated, strict, loving and protective.
Reggie: African American man, 18–25. Funny, confident and charming.
Windle: African American man, 35–50. Mature, confident and emotionally complex.
Stone: African American man, 30–50. Strong, intimidating and authoritative.
Dak: African American man, 18–28. Tall, athletic, attractive and charismatic.
FOXX: African American, 18–30. Talented, competitive and confident with a strong stage presence.
Female Rival Rapper: African American woman, 18–30. Fierce, confident, hard and street-smart.
Frost: African American man, 30–50. Mature, outspoken and commanding.
Becky: African American woman, 18–25. Intelligent, ambitious, friendly and outspoken.
Rosa Lee: Hispanic/Latina woman, 18–25. Intelligent, caring, ambitious and confident.
Big Man/Dre: African American man, 25–40. Large or physically strong, protective, funny and dependable.
Arielle: African American woman, 18–30. Attractive, social, expressive and self-assured.
Lisa: Caucasian woman, 18–25. Attractive, friendly, social and expressive.
Teenage Girl: Caucasian girl, 14–17. Youthful, confident and expressive.
Young Woman: Caucasian woman, 18–25. Friendly, confident and outgoing.
Ms. Debbie: African American woman, 40–65. Warm, confident and musically gifted. Must be able to sing.
Pastor: African American man or woman, 35–65. Mature, spiritual, compassionate and authoritative.
Professor Dunlap: Man or woman of any ethnicity, 35–65. Professional, intelligent and authoritative.
Teen Rappers/Students: Boys and girls, 14–17, of all ethnicities. Must be energetic and expressive. Rap ability is preferred.
Adult Extras: Men and women, 18+, of all ethnicities. College students, dancers, musicians, judges, church members and audience members.
Choose a character and clearly state who you are auditioning for. Please submit:
Your headshot
Acting résumé, if available
A video of your best monologue
A short rap performance when applying for a rap role
Parents or legal guardians must submit or approve submissions for anyone under 18.
Send submissions to Carterboyzent2017@gmail.com.
Thank you for your interest!
Carterboyz Entertainment

CASTING CALL — POPO!
We’re looking for people interested in being part of a new comedy show/short film called “POPO,” a parody inspired by the style of COPS.

Location: Peninsula, Ohio

Filming begins TOMORROW and continues throughout this month

We’re currently looking for:

SUSPECTS — People willing to play ridiculous, funny, or suspicious characters.

WITNESSES — People who can give funny “interviews” and tell their side of the story.

DISPATCHERS — Potential voice-over roles for dispatch calls.

BYSTANDERS — People appearing naturally in the background or reacting to what’s happening.

COMEDIC CHARACTERS — Various funny and unusual characters throughout the show.

EXTRAS — Anyone who wants to be part of the scenes and help bring the world of POPO to life.

No professional acting experience is necessary. If you can improvise, have a sense of humor, or just want to try something different, we’d love to have you.

The idea is to make it feel like a serious police reality show while everything around the “officers” is completely ridiculous.

If you’re interested in participating, comment below or send me a message and let me know what type of role you’d be interested in.

POPO — Because somebody has to patrol Peninsula.

Message my account if interested.

CREW CALL: Low-budget independent documentary / educational film

"The Better Body Starter Kit For Men" is a feature-length documentary on the subject of men's fitness, including actual teaching content, so that viewers will be not only motivated to take their fitness seriously, but will have the tools to get started as well.  This listing is for ONE scene, a teaching module identifying the groupings of muscle on the male body for the purpose of organizing more effective workouts.

TITLE & TYPE: "The Better Body Starter Kit For Men" / Feature Film, Documentary, Educational

CREW: Cinematographer [Glorified Camera Operator]
- Production Assistant

LOCATION: Prineville, Oregon, USA

TIME: Saturday, September 19, 2026
8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (or earlier if we finish earlier)

COMPENSATION: Cinematographer: $200
- Production Assistant: $100
- Lunch provided
- Funded by my own work paychecks so Compensation may be delayed but IS guaranteed.  [This is my first attempt at a feature film; the last thing I want is a bad reputation at the very beginning.]
- Not a union shoot

APPLYING: For Cinematographer, please include a reel or demo or YouTube channel - any proof that you have experience and I won't be training someone who's never framed up a good shot of film.
- All applications ASAP as the shoot is 10 days away.
- The scene will be focused on a male model stripped down to a speedo for visibility of all the muscle groups; applicants should be comfortable filming this.  (At no time will the model be naked; content is academic in tone, non-sexual.)

CONTACT: Brian Johnson
- bigtigerproductions@outlook.com

🎭 $175 FAREWELL HEADSHOT SPECIAL (Moving to New York)
Hey everyone! 😊 I’m officially moving to New York this October, so I’m doing a $175 Farewell Headshot Special before I go! October 9th will be my last day shooting in California.

What’s included:

-1-hour headshot session

-Unlimited looks/outfit changes

-1 professionally retouched image included

-Full access to all your RAW files

-Professional hair & makeup add-on available

Availability is limited between now and October 9th, so if you’ve been needing fresh headshots or want to add some new looks before I leave California, feel free to message me and we’ll set up a time!

🌐 www.kooheadshots.com

📸 Instagram: @kooheadshots

Looking forward to working with some of you before the big move! 😊🗽

TV Production Partners: Cast, Crew & Investors

Are you a producer with a production studio looking for your next project? I am seeking experienced producers, investors, and industry professionals to help bring a finished TV show script to life.I have a finished TV show script. Now I need the team to make it happen.

I am looking for Producers and Production Studios who can invest in their own content. If you have a studio, a network of cast and crew, and PR connections in the entertainment industry, I want to talk to you.

What I Am Looking For:

Producers/Investors: Individuals or studios with the financial capability to invest in their own TV shows.

Production Studios: Access to your own facilities and resources to produce the project.

Network: Cast and crew who are ready to work on a new series.

PR: Professionals with connections in the entertainment industry to help with distribution and publicity.

If you have the infrastructure and the network to produce a TV series, I have the script. Let’s collaborate. Please answer the membership questions or DM me directly to discuss the project.

This is your chance to work in person on the Sound Stage at Marc Graue Voice Over Studios in Burbank. 🚨!!! CASTING CALL FOR HORROR SHORT FILM !!! 🚨

Hey everyone! My brother Derrick and I are shooting a short film called “Mono” and have two roles left to fill. Please see the details and character descriptions below.

FILMING LOCATION: Dade City, FL (Local Hires Only)

DARK FIGURE: 
Man (any age) - Preferably bald or black hair. Tall, lanky, with distinctively unique features who has the presence of a wendigo/ skinwalker (wicked smile, gaunt frame, sunken eyes, etc.). 
Non-speaking monster role that requires SFX makeup from the head to the waist, with colored contact lenses. 
$250/day for 1 day (10 hours max) of work.
Working on September 28th.
IMDb credit and meals on set will be provided.

MAN IN GAZEBO: 
Man (45-70) - Big and stocky build with an eerie presence (haggard face, sinister smile, tired look, etc.). 
Non-speaking featured extra role. 
$100/day for 1 day (3 hours max) of work.
Working on September 29th. 
IMDb credit and meals on set will be provided.

Please send me a message directly on Messenger or email me at drake.sr.clowes@gmail.com confirming your availability and a Headshot if interested. Thank you!

SPREAD THE WORD!!!

#castingcalls #shortfilmmaking #indiefilmmaker #horrorshortfilm #monoshortfilm

Submission due September 18

Open Auditions for Kids “The Sound of Music” on Broadway

Open auditions announced for Oscar & Hammerstein’s musical “The Sound of Music” on Broadway.

Deadline coming up!

This audition notice is for the 2027 season.

The Sound of Music is a musical set in Austria on the eve of World War II. The story follows Maria, a young woman preparing to become a nun who is sent to serve as governess to the seven children of widowed naval captain Georg von Trapp. Through music, warmth, and a strong sense of family, Maria brings new life to the household and eventually falls in love with the captain. The musical features classic songs including “Do-Re-Mi,” “My Favorite Things,” “Edelweiss,” and “Climb Ev’ry Mountain.”

The telsey office released the following casting notice:

Please note that they are taking online audition submissions – However those selected may need to attend in-person auditions in New York.Audition Notice:
OPEN SUBMISSION CALL FOR THE BROADWAY PRODUCTION OF THE SOUND OF MUSIC

Seeking children to play the following roles:

FRIEDRICH VON TRAPP
LOUISA VON TRAPP
KURT VON TRAPP
BRIGITTA VON TRAPP
MARTA VON TRAPP
GRETL VON TRAPP
Audition Notice Details:
THE SOUND OF MUSIC on Broadway 2027 — Seeking Virtual Submissions for von Trapp Children
This Google form is set up to collect submission videos for the six roles that will be played by juvenile actors in the Broadway revival of THE SOUND OF MUSIC at Lincoln Center Theater. These roles are Friedrich, Louisa, Kurt, Brigitta, Marta, and Gretl von Trapp. All juvenile actors should be at least seven years of age by the rehearsal start date of February 1, 2027.

No professional experience necessary to audition. We encourage performers of all gender identities to submit. SEEKING NEW YORK LOCAL HIRES. AUTHORIZATION TO LEGALLY WORK IN THE UNITED STATES IS REQUIRED.

Submissions are due by September 18, 2026.

THE SOUND OF MUSIC

Broadway – Vivian Beaumont Theater
Contract: LORT A+ ($2,244 weekly minimum)
Producer: Lincoln Center Theater (Lear deBessonet, Kewsong Lee Artistic Director; Nicole Kastrinos, Stacey and Eric Mindich Producer)
Book: Howard Lindsay and Russel Crouse
Music: Richard Rodgers
Lyrics: Oscar Hammerstein II
Based on the “The Trapp Family Singers” by Maria Augusta Trapp
Director: Lear deBessonet
Choreographer: Christopher Gattelli
Music Director: Mary-Mitchell Campbell
Casting: The Telsey Office
Rehearsals: February 1, 2027
Previews: March 23, 2027
Opening: April 15, 2027
Scheduled run through: July 18, 2027
____________

SUBMISSION TAPING INSTRUCTIONS:
Material is available at the link below.
THE SOUND OF MUSIC MATERIALS

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/bmn3ut2y4clunnl85wyvv/ADhHUn5luj5T9gLfi7pidYc?rlkey=vd0xnnxgrvwpbr5gd8pyzyehc&st=lqmcy6oc&dl=0

Please record the following (You may submit these as three separate files):

1) A slate that includes your name, your height, where you are currently based, and a full body shot. For those under the age of 18, please state your date of birth. For those auditioning for the roles of MARTA and GRETL, please also verbally confirm that you will be age seven by the rehearsal start date of February 1, 2027.

2) If you are auditioning for the roles of FRIEDRICH or KURT, please prepare the cut of “So Long, Farewell.” If you are auditioning for the roles of LOUISA, BRIGITTA, MARTA, or GRETL, please prepare either “Do-Re-Mi” or “My Favorite Things (Reprise)” — CHOOSE ONE. There are teaching (“plunk”) MP3s for each song to help you learn it. Then when you are ready to record, you should use the accompaniment MP3.

3) Please record one side for the character for which you feel you are best suited.

If you are using an iPhone to video record, please be sure to film horizontally and in a well-lit space (not backlit). Please provide a viewable/downloadable link in the appropriate box below. We are not able to download files (i.e. WeTransfer, Hightail). Dropbox and Google Drive tend to work best (and REMINDER TO MAKE THE SETTINGS ACCESSIBLE TO ANYONE WITH THE LINK — we are not able to request access!). Reminder that YouTube links are not downloadable, so best to avoid YouTube.

For more information on how to submit, please visit the link below:
https://tinyurl.com/THESOUNDOFMUSICLCT2027
Submissions are due by September 18, 2026

**Poszukujemy aktorów do krótkometrażowego thrillera psychologicznego „ZMORA” NON PROFIT:**

 - Aktora do roli głównej (REMI) 

aktorów drugoplanowych: 
- DEALER 
- BEATKA
- SĄSIADKA

**O filmie: „ZMORA”** to duszny, kameralny thriller psychologiczny o skrajnym wycieńczeniu, uzależnieniu i braku kontroli. Akcja skupia się na relacji dwójki bohaterów zamkniętych w jednym mieszkaniu: Mai zmagającej się z halucynacjami z braku snu oraz Remiego przechodzącego przez ciężki zespół odstawienny.

Postać: **REMI** (wiek wizualny: 20–28 lat) - przyjaciel Mai, który przechodzi przez skrajnie wyniszczający zespół odstawienny po fentanylu. Postać wymagająca ogromnej świadomości ciała – charakteryzująca się potwornym osłabieniem, dreszczami, zimnymi potami, skrajnym niepokojem i głębokim bólami mięśniowymi. Szukamy aktora gotowego na bardzo realistyczną, przejmującą pracę aktorską.

Postać: **DEALER** - dobrze zbudowany mężczyzna. Doświadczenie mile widziane, ale nie wymagane. 

Postać: **BEATKA** (wiek wizualny: 40-50 lat) - pracownica biura, koleżanka z pracy Mai. 
Doświadczenie wymagane. 

Postać: **SĄSIADKA **(wiek wizualny: 50 pare lat) - sąsiadka z bloku Mai, jest właścicielką królika. Starsza pani z nowoczesnym wyglądem. Jasne włosy. 
Doświadczenie wymagane.

Materiały do portfolio i prace ze świetną ekipą

🎬 CASTING CALL

WE ARE LOOKING FOR CHILDREN AND TEENAGERS AGED 5–17 WITH A UNIQUE, EXOTIC LOOK!

We are looking for participants to take part in an exciting research project focused on smart home technology.

📍 Location: Warsaw
📅 Dates: October
⏰ Time: Between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM

The exact date and time of participation will be arranged individually.

⏱️ Duration: Approximately 1 hour
💰 Payment: 700 PLN gross

────────────────────

During the study, participants will be asked to act out short scenarios related to everyday life in a smart home.

ℹ️ All information collected during the study will be used exclusively for the company’s internal purposes.

📩 HOW TO APPLY: casting@twarze.pl

Please include “Smart Home” in the subject line of your email.

Please send us:

• 2 recent photos of the child (please do not send more than 2 photos)
• Child’s first name
• Age
• Place of residence
• Contact phone number

If your child already has a profile with our agency, simply send us their profile ID number.

We look forward to receiving your applications!

www.twarze.pl

🎬 CASTING CALL — HOLLYVILLE
We’re casting Joe for our indie mystery/horror short filming in Vancouver, Oct. 2–4.

Joe: Man, 35 to 45 years old; all ethnicities. Joe (30s) is Mary’s husband and partner in Hollyville’s neighbourhood watch. Quiet, steady, and unfailingly pleasant, Joe is less probing than Mary but every bit as observant.

Non-union, volunteer. IMDb credit, footage, and food provided.

📩 Submit your demo and resume by Sept. 14 to info@rollthedieproductions.com

Wir haben noch die letzten 2 freien Plätze für einen Dreh mit kurzen, lustigen Videos in Wien! 🎬
📍 Wo? Wien, MuseumsQuartier, in der Nähe vom mumok
📅 Wann? Freitag, 11.9.
⏱ Dauer: ca. 10–20 Minuten. Danach kannst du direkt wieder gehen.
💶 Bezahlung: 40 € bar vor Ort
🎥 Videoformat:
Street Interviews mit ein paar lustigen Fragen und einfacher Logik.
Die Scripts schicken wir dir im Voraus. Kein Stress und du musst nichts auswendig lernen.
✅ Wen suchen wir?
– Männer und Frauen, die sich vor der Kamera wohlfühlen
– Schauspieler, Schauspielstudenten und extrovertierte Persönlichkeiten
– jeden, der ein lustiges Video für sein Portfolio möchte oder einfach eine interessante Erfahrung machen will
📩 Schreib uns eine Nachricht, wenn du Interesse hast. Die Plätze sind begrenzt.
👉 Falls wir dir beim letzten Mal nicht geantwortet haben, kannst du uns gerne noch einmal schreiben.

I’ve been working on this for a while and it’s finally at the point where I’d like some people to try it.

The Actor’s Books is a simple way for supporting artists, actors and performers to keep track of jobs, fees, payments and expenses in one place.

If you work in the industry, I’d really appreciate any feedback — what works, what doesn’t, or what you think is missing.

**URGENT CASTING CALL New York City: [PAID]**
Looking for Non-Union Male actor to play ARES in WONDER WOMAN FAN FILM that will be on YouTube Channel with over 80 Million views!

Need to be available for rehearsal **THIS MONDAY (9/14) 3PM **in Brooklyn for a FIGHT CHOREOGRAPHY! And need 1 day available for shoot day week of 9/15-9/19 or beginning of October 1-7. Will discuss schedule.

Actor should be okay doing fight choreography (you're not doing any crazy stunts!) and it's for the epic fight scene between Ares and Wonder Woman.

We are looking for someone:
Non-Union Actor
Height: At Least 5'10" or taller
Fit, Strong looking
Any Ethnicity
Age: 20s, 30s, or 40s
Prefer someone with some martial arts or kickboxing experience, or stage combat experience. (can even be Ren Faire experience)

This Ares is like the one from XENA: WARRIOR PRINCESS, so bring out your swagger! You don't have to look like him (you can be bald), but you should have his VIBE! Our last fan film, Spider-Woman vs. Doc Ock, got selected as Outstanding Series by the Shortform Gala.

Day Rate for 1 day Film Shoot: $300-$400
+ Rehearsal Day Rate: $150 (you will be paid after rehearsal)

**EMAIL ME ASAP at tiger@independence-studios.com**
Your Headshots, Resume, social media links, any martial arts or kickboxing or dance experience (you're not dancing but dancers are great at fight choreo too), Acting Reel, and any action/fight reel IF you have any (not required).

We have to fill this role ASAP!

EMAIL ME ONLY!  No DMs!  Just EMAIL!

Thank you!

🌟 **CHCESZ WYSTĄPIĆ NA DUŻEJ SCENIE PRZED KONCERTAMI LANBERRY I KUBY SZMAJKOWSKIEGO?**

19 września w **G City Promenada w Warszawie** odbędzie się Wielki Finał Talent Show **„Zostań Gwiazdą”**. Tego dnia otwieramy scenę również dla **młodych artystów, zespołów, grup tanecznych, szkół, akademii i innych ciekawych talentów!**

🎤 **W godz. 11:00–14:00 szukamy osób i grup, które chciałyby wystąpić na scenie i zaprezentować się przed publicznością**, jeszcze przed finałem Talent Show oraz koncertami **Kuby Szmajkowskiego i Lanberry**.

To świetna okazja, żeby:
✨ pokazać swój talent na profesjonalnej scenie,
✨ opowiedzieć o sobie, swoim zespole lub szkole,
✨ zdobyć doświadczenie i dać się zauważyć,
✨ otrzymać zdjęcia z występu do własnego portfolio,
✨ promować siebie, swoją grupę, akademię czy projekt.

Śpiewasz? Tańczysz? Grasz? Masz zespół, grupę akrobatyczną albo zupełnie inny talent? **Napisz do nas!** 🌟

⭐ *Występy w godz. 11:00–14:00 mają charakter promocyjny*

**A może chcesz zawalczyć o finał i nagrody?** 🏆
17 i 18 września odbędą się również **castingi do Talent Show dla dzieci i młodzieży w wieku 6–16 lat**. Spośród uczestników wybranych zostanie 10 finalistów, którzy 19 września wystąpią przed jury: **Lanberry, Rafałem Maserakiem i Kubą Szmajkowskim**. Do wygrania m.in. **5000 zł za I miejsce!**

📅 **19 września | G City Promenada, Warszawa**
🎤 11:00–14:00 – występy gościnne
⭐ 14:00–15:00 – finał Talent Show
🎶 15:00 – Kuba Szmajkowski
🎶 15:30 – Lanberry
🏆 16:00 – ogłoszenie wyników

**Chcesz wystąpić między 11:00 a 14:00? Napisz do nas w wiadomości prywatnej lub na mail: marketing@agencja5am.pl**

CASTING CALL | PAID PHOTOSHOOT | COLORADO SPRINGS

Axis is casting grandparents and teens/young adults for a lifestyle photoshoot celebrating the relationship between grandparents and their grandchildren.

Date: Thursday, September 24
Location: Colorado Springs, CO
Time: Approximately 2-hour windows
Pay: $200 flat rate per person
PHOTOSHOOT ONLY. No video or dialogue.

Seeking:
• Grandmas & Grandpas, ages 60–75
• Teens/young adults, ages 14–20
• A variety of ethnicities and family backgrounds

Photos will feature natural moments like baking together, playing games, reading the Bible, playing chess, celebrating a graduation, cheering at a football game, and working on a car.

Real grandparents and grandchildren are encouraged to submit together, but you do not need to be related. No professional experience required.

To submit: Email irene@axis.org with your name, age, current photo/headshot, phone number, and availability on September 24. If submitting together, please include information and photos for each person.

items.text:
𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 & 𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋

Hey there, our lovely industry! I’m entering the second phase of Pre-Production and I’m still needing some help for our Thriller Short Indie Film, Cartyr!
𝙈𝙤𝙧𝙚 𝙨𝙤 𝙤𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙘𝙧𝙚𝙬 𝙨𝙞𝙙𝙚 <—
𝙗𝙪𝙩 𝙤𝙥𝙚𝙣 𝙨𝙥𝙤𝙩𝙨 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙘𝙖𝙨𝙩

Logline: After being convicted and sent to a psychiatric institution, a mass-murdering serial killer is brought in for another mandated therapy session with his doctor—but this time, something is different.

ᴀʙᴏᴜᴛ ᴛʜᴇ ᴘʀᴏᴊᴇᴄᴛ
Production Type: Independent Short Film
Genre: Horror / Thriller
Runtime: Approximately 10 minutes
Filming Window: The 2nd-3rd Week of October.
Location: Colorado Springs, CO.

This is currently an unpaid independent project. Food will be provided during filming, and all cast and crew will receive full film credits and IMDb credit.

The production is expected to require 2–3 days of filming, with the majority of scenes taking place indoors.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋 
Young Cartyr
Age: 8-14
Physical Description:
- Brown Hair
- Hazel eyes hopefully but Green/Brown Eyes work too. 
- Mixed Hispanic/Caucasian.
Role: Supporting
I need a young performer who fits a younger version of me. He must appear hollow, falsely empathetic, cold but not fully unnerving yet at this time in his life. Must be careful with loud performances and things being thrown about.

The Victims
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Number Needed: 3
Role: Background / Supporting
Three performers needed to loom over the scene and, through body language and physical presence, showing that they silently despise what they see in front of them.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

Extras
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Background
Various victims who will appear briefly throughout intense scenes.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋
Producer: A producer would be nice to help with logistics, scheduling and such. It’s been a headache to handle with just myself and my co-owner! Those also potentially helping fund small things would be nice but not required.

1st AD: I will also be acting in the film, so I would greatly appreciate someone who can help keep production moving.

Boom Op/Sound Engineer: Probably the biggest things right now. Someone with experience or the equipment to spare!
But background in recording audio and working with post-production sound would be greatly appreciated. Or help with sound in general!

(A shotgun microphone and/or boom setup would also be extremely helpful.)

Editor: 
An editor is not absolutely required at this stage, but if I can find an editor for post-production, it would be DEEPLY appreciated and would help take some pressure off me.

𝑳𝑶𝑪𝑨𝑻𝑰𝑶𝑵𝑺
There is a scene set in a closed doctors office. A mental institution. A closed space would do nicely or if anyone has an actual space we can use that fits it, minus the windows, doctors office, chairs, desk, whatever! It’ll would be helpful. Thank you! 

𝑪𝑶𝑵𝑻𝑨𝑪𝑻 𝑰𝑵𝑭𝑶𝑹𝑴𝑨𝑻𝑰𝑶𝑵
If you’re interested in a cast or crew position, or simply want to help with the project in any capacity, feel free to comment, message, or (preferably) email:
morelandcreativearts@gmail.com

For Cast Applicants,
If you’re interested in a casting role, please submit your headshot, reel, and resume if you have them.

This film shall either be set on a weekend of the 2nd or 3rd week October. This casting call is currently for pre-production and early recruitment purposes.

Thank you for your help!

# WROCŁAW / TRUDNE SPRAWY

Szukamy nowych aktorów do nowego odcinka **Trudnych Spraw! **Proszę o uważne przeczytanie charakterystyki i wieku postaci - zgłoszenia kompletnie niezgodne z rolą nie będą rozpatrywane.

Zgłoszenia dla osób z ***WROCŁAWIA I WOJEWÓDZTWA DOLNOŚLĄSKIEGO***:

** **

**Dariusz (wiek kandydata: 39-44 lata)**

Wygląd: przystojny i chryzmatyczny

Szczegóły: kolega jednego z bohaterów, ciągle chętny do kolejnych podbojów miłosnych i romansów, pewny siebie podrywacz.

1 scena: 24.09, wyjazd o 6:00

 

**Kasia (wiek kandydatki 25-30 lat) – dziewczyna Dariusza**

Wygląd: atrakcyjna, kobieca figura, najlepiej typ klepsydry

**Szczegóły: zalotna, imprezowa. Wysyła swojemu chłopakowi nagie fotki.**

2 sceny: 24.09, wyjazd o 6:00

 

Płatność gotówką od razu po planie, ceny ustalane w zależności od roli. Osoby zainteresowane proszę o wysłanie wiadomości o tytule "Trudne Sprawy + IMIĘ postaci" wraz z:
* **aktualnymi** zdjęciami twarzy i sylwetki,
* wiekiem,
* wzrostem i wagą,
* numerem telefonu,
* materiałami video z odcinków, w których występowałeś/aś (jeżeli grałeś/aś w przeszłości),
* wideo wizytówką (ok. 1-minutowe nagranie, w którym przedstawiamy się, mówimy o swoim doświadczeniu aktorskim, pasjach i hobby).

na maila julia.lisowiec@polotmedia.pl lub w wiadomości prywatnej na Facebooku. Jeżeli dostaną Państwo ode mnie pozytywną odpowiedź będą Państwo poproszeni o odegranie sceny ze scenariusza.

Proszę o kontakt WYŁĄCZNIE osoby dyspozycyjne w podanych terminach, w podanym przedziale wiekowym oraz pochodzącym z odpowiedniej lokalizacji.

🎬 THANK YOU RUNCORN! ❤️

A massive thank you to everyone who got in touch after yesterday's post. We honestly had an amazing response!

We've now started putting together a register of everyone interested in getting involved, and our production manager will be in touch over the next week or two with more information.

There are a whole host of opportunities across the production, including:

🏃 Runners
🚧 Location marshalls
🎬 Production assistants
📋 Location support
🚗 Parking & equipment help
👥 Background artists
🎭 Stand-ins
☕ Tea & coffee specialists 😂
🍕 Food and set support
🧠 People who are good at solving problems when everything goes wrong
😂 And probably someone whose main job is telling Terry to calm down!

Because we've got such a professional core of cast and crew already in place, we're able to give people from our local community the opportunity to experience what it's like being part of a real film production.

Most of the background and supporting crew roles will be unpaid, although refreshments will be provided.

So don't forget, if you want to be involved and think you've got something to bring to the party, we want to hear from you!

From making brews to doing stunts... 😂

There might just be a place for you somewhere on this mad little production.

🎬 We're getting very close now!

🎬 EVER WANTED TO BE A SUPPORTING ARTIST (EXTRA) IN A FILM? 🎬
Here’s your chance to give it a go!

The Eight Saga N.E.S.T Project is looking for Supporting Artists (SAs) for its next shoot in Mossley, Manchester on 19th & 20th September.

We’re filming the first of eight feature films in an exciting post-apocalyptic horror project.

🎥 WATCH THE TRAILER HERE:

The Eight Saga N.E.S.T Project – YouTube Trailer⁠

https://youtu.be/ZcnOh7Klxqo

🎭 Roles include guards, civilians and victims, with plenty of opportunity to get involved in front of the camera during a big action shoot.

⚠️ This is unpaid, but everyone taking part will receive an IMDb credit.

If you’ve ever wondered what it would be like to become a Supporting Artist, this is the ideal opportunity to experience being on a film set, meet a friendly community and become part of the N.E.S.T world.

Interested in joining us?

📱 Message our Casting Director Simon Hall directly on WhatsApp: 07894 943405 — messages only please, no calls.

Please include: • A recent headshot (a phone photo is fine)

• Full name

• Age

• Email address

• Whether you’re available 19th September, 20th September, or both

🎬 Come and be part of something amazing! 🌟

#nonpaid #nonuion

 **CASTING CALL — GROOSE | THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: SKYWARD SWORD**

Are you a **Legend of Zelda fan** interested in voice acting? I’m looking for a voice actor to portray **Groose** in a fan-made *The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword* project!

 **ABOUT GROOSE:**

Groose is loud, confident, competitive, and often acts like he’s the toughest guy in Skyloft. Beneath his boastful personality, he has a good heart and genuinely cares about those around him.

**AUDITION INSTRUCTIONS:**

Audition lines will be provided specifically for the character you are auditioning for.

When recording:

• **No slate is necessary.** Begin directly with the audition lines.
• **Stick strictly to the provided lines.**
• **No improvisation.** Do not add or change dialogue.
• **No intention repeats.** Each line should only be performed once.
• Please submit **one complete audio file** containing your entire audition.

Accepted formats: **MP3 or WAV**.
• **Do not send multiple audio attachments.** Your audition must be contained in **one single MP3 or WAV file**.
• Failure to follow these submission requirements will result in the audition being **rejected**.

📅 **AUDITION DEADLINE**

**October 13, 2026**

📩 **SUBMIT YOUR AUDITION**

Send your completed audition as **one MP3 or WAV attachment** to:

**[linkhyrule776@yahoo.ca](mailto:linkhyrule776@yahoo.ca)**

 **PROJECT PRIVACY**

This is a **fan-made project created by fans, for fans.**

To keep the project private during production, **my YouTube channel will not be revealed during casting.**

If you are selected for the role, my YouTube channel and additional project information will be revealed **after production and once you have been chosen for the role.**

Groose's Lines: 
* **On Life Advice:** "My advice? Work hard and wish with all your heart. You might even come in second." 

* **On His Iconic Hairstyle:** "You lay off the do right now, or I'll flatten you. Everyone knows I've got the slickest pompadour in town.

* **On Renaming the Surface World:** "This place needs a name. Yeah... A name fitting for this rugged, adventurous wilderness. From now on, we'll call it... Grooseland!" 

* **On Bullying Link Early On:** "Oh, wait... I got it. You're here to talk about today's race. I can see it in those dopey eyes of yours. They're pleading, 'Oh, Groose, can you please find it in your heart to let me win today? Please!'" 

* **On Dragging the Academy's Name:** "Would you wake up, straighten up, and grow a backbone already? Dopes like you are dragging our honored academy through the mud." 

* **On Stealing Link's Crimson Loftwing:** "Course it was. You thought a big Crimson Loftwing like that was gonna go down without a fight? But we got him... He's not getting out of that pen anytime soon, boys." 
* 
* **On His Redemption and Guarding the Sealed Grounds:** "Nah, don't worry about me. I'm gonna hang back here, Link... Someone's gotta stick around and guard the place. Might as well be me. Besides, if I'm not here, who's gonna look out for the old girl?" 

* **On Rebranding the Entire Game:** "Nice going, you two. You guys were totally amazing in this little adventure I like to call the Legend of Groose. ... That's a little joke."

**CASTING CALL | COUPLES | SUNSHINE COAST, BC**

I’m looking for **two couples** who would love to spend 2–3 nights at a beautiful private oceanfront property on the Sunshine Coast and be part of a television filming and lifestyle content shoot.

Villa Sol in Halfmoon Bay is being featured in a Canadian travel television series on **Tuesday, September 29**, and we’re looking for couples who are natural and comfortable in front of the camera to help bring the experience of the property to life.

**The exchange:**

A complimentary 2–3 night stay at Villa Sol in exchange for participating in the filming and lifestyle content. There is no additional monetary compensation. **Transportation/ferry costs and meals are not included.**

During the filming, you may be captured experiencing different parts of the property — sauna, hot tub, oceanfront, decks, fireside spaces, yoga/sound and other lifestyle moments — as well as some additional Villa Sol photography and video during the stay.

**We’re looking for couples who:**

• Are available September 29 and flexible to be on standby throughout the filming day

• Are comfortable being photographed and filmed, both individually and together

• Feel natural and relaxed on camera

• Are comfortable signing appropriate photo/video releases

• Are happy participating in lifestyle and wellness experiences around the property

• Ideally have an active social media presence and enjoy sharing travel, wellness, nature or lifestyle experiences with their community

The right fit for us is less about traditional modelling experience and more about finding people who genuinely fit the Villa Sol experience and will be comfortable having a fun, relaxed few days while we capture it.

**Interested? Please DM me with:**

• Both of your names and ages

• A recent photo together

• Your social media handles

• Where you’ll be travelling from

• Confirmation that you’re both available September 29

• A little about yourselves and why the experience appeals to you

I’ll be choosing two couples based on overall fit for the property and filming.

Villa Sol is located in **Halfmoon Bay on BC’s Sunshine Coast** and requires ferry travel for those coming from the Vancouver area. 

Please visit [www.solunastays.ca](https://www.solunastays.ca/) to get a sense of the property.
